Team —

Quick alignment note: Novacorp signaled they want the legal/contract loop closed the week of Dec 7 and an executive-level endorsement (EB session) the preceding week. I pulled together a short mutual action plan and a proposed two-hour EB panel slot to push the close across the line. Attaching the MAP draft and a preliminary EB agenda.

Ask (fast):
- Review the MAP (RDW_MAP_v3.xlsx) for completeness — focus on acceptance criteria in the evaluation column.
- Confirm owners for: runbook walkthrough (Ben), performance gates (Karthik), exec briefing deck (Marissa).
- Pick 3 preferred EB windows (Nov 30 — Dec 4 local times) we should offer Novacorp. We need 2-hour contiguous blocks that work for Redwood execs + Novacorp C-suite.

Key constraints:
- Novacorp procurement wants ok from legal by EOD Dec 9.
- Customer evaluation includes a 48-hour load test and a security checklist (SOC 2 artifacts requested).
- Close target: Dec 15 (internal goal) — but must be flexible if procurement needs more time.

I'll run a single consolidated reply to Novacorp with our top windows and an updated MAP.

Thanks —
Rachel

Good capture. A few quick notes after skimming the MAP:

- EB timing: I prefer Dec 1 (11:00–13:00 PST) or Dec 2 (09:00–11:00 PST). Those options keep us weekdays and allow legal time afterward.

I'll add a short slide to the EB deck on risk mitigations (quantization/backup model) and mark the MAP row for load-test acceptance.

—Karthik

- Load test: 48-hour window starting Nov 30 09:00 PST — Redwood will run a controlled synthetic test that ramps to 2.2x baseline traffic.
- Metrics: P95 inference latency <= 420ms; 99% token generation success rate; 95% request success rate during peak traffic. Pass/fail criteria are in the MAP evaluation column.
- Owners: Ben — runbook walkthrough & demo; Karthik — load-test execution and post-test analysis; Marissa — exec deck and customer-facing ROI slides; Rachel — procurement/contract coordination and EB facilitation.
- Legal handoff: I will upload the redline to procurement@novacorp.com within 24 hours of the EB session; legal at Redwood will standby for immediate review.

Proposed EB attendance (Redwood): CTO, VP Product (Marissa), SE lead (Karthik), Solutions AE (Rachel). Please confirm Novacorp speaker list and whether you want a short prerecorded demo segment.

If this looks good, I'll send the calendar invite + Zoom details and loop legal for the redline.

Best —
Rachel
